maria (sec): alert: scanned partner artifact partner-42/build-2026-03-23.tar.gz and found an Azure SAS URL in plaintext (sv= se= sig=).
kevin (eng): yikes. can you paste sanitized match?
maria (sec): matched: https://partner-42.blob.core.windows.net/release/art.tgz?sv=2024-01-01&se=2026-12-31&sig=REDACTED
jane (platform): tagging oncall. recommendation: disable partner webhook intake to stop further pulls until rotated.
tim (devex): i'll inventory consumers (ingest lambda, nightly snapshot job, partner runners).
maria (sec): logs show reads only from ingestion principal and partner IPs. still a secret leak; compliance requires rotation and audit.
kevin (eng): plan: rotate storage account keys (both), provision ephemeral SAS via Vault issuance, push new SAS into Vault path secret/data/partners/partner-42/sas, and update ingest to read from Vault.
jane (platform): enforce RBAC: rotate-job SPN only gets Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listKeys/action; consumers get blob/read. enable diagnostic settings -> LogAnalytics and export to secure-logs.
tim (devex): i'll create Vault policy with read-only capability and set TTL to 1h; rotation cron every 30m.
oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2026-0471 created and oncall paged.
maria (sec): action items assigned: kevin rotate keys & push SAS to Vault, tim add Vault policy & cron, jane block webhook until Vault flow confirmed, kevin open PR to update ingest.
kevin (eng): rotated key1; key2 next. created test SAS 2h, pushed to Vault, PR: https://git.redwood.internal/ingest/+/2401
jane (platform): webhook blocked; partner notified to retry. enabled storage analytics export -> log-archive/partner-42.
maria (sec): validate old SAS is invalid and attach audit logs to SEC-2026-0471.
kevin (eng): smoke test ok; old SAS returns 403. no write ops observed.
maria (sec): follow-up: add pre-ingest artifact secret-scan, CI lint to fail on sv=|se=|sig=, and draft partner onboarding RFC requiring Vault/KMS-backed tokens. closing once logs + PR linked. :thumbsup:
